user.title: Fine Day
user.description: Fine Day tells you whether today is a good day to dry the washing, or paint, or mow. It needs a key from SumnerD: email {contact} about Fine Day for one. The server address is already filled in.

place.title: Where are you?
place.description: Type your suburb, or your town if it's a small one. Any NZ suburb or locality works, macrons optional.

pick.title: Which one?
pick.description: Only the first 20 matches show. If yours isn't here, pick None of these and search again.

reauth_confirm.title: Fine Day needs a new key
reauth_confirm.description: The server no longer accepts this key. Enter the new one, or email {contact} about Fine Day for a key.

error.invalid_auth: That key isn't valid, or has been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address.
error.rate_limited: This key has used its requests for today. Try again after midnight.
error.invalid_url: The address should start with https://
error.no_match: Nothing matched. Try a different spelling, or the nearest town.
error.address_blocked: The server won't take this key from here (it's locked to another address, or it's been used from too many places today). Email hello@sumnerd.co.nz about Fine Day.

abort.already_configured: That place is already set up.

data_description.daylight_only: Only look for dry windows between sunrise and sunset.
